prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was bouncing between cities a lot—one leg was from Beijing to Shanghai, and it felt like I lived on the rails.
I also remember we were comparing places to stay in Shanghai that same trip, just chatting about neighborhoods and hotels over coffee.
My coworker later told me they took the G3 on 2025-04-08, and the ticket was under Ma Liang—pretty sure it was First Class too.
And yeah, that same ticket detail stuck with me because they specifically mentioned First Class like it was a huge win.
Separate thing: my friend was raving about Chengdu attractions after their visit, and on another old work trip Liu Yang stayed at the Pudong Shangri-La—checked in 2025-03-12 for 3 nights.
